property_summary: Transfers never change the totalSupply and preserve the sum of balances of two involved accounts (from + to) when neither is frozen and transfer does not revert.
If this contract (the test) calls transfer(to, amount) and it does not revert, then totalSupply is unchanged.

Only the owner can successfully call burn: for any caller (this test contract calling burn) the call either reverts or results in decreased totalSupply equal to the burned amount and decreased caller balance by the same amount.

If freezeAccount(target, freeze) is called (by this contract) then afterwards frozenAccount(target) equals the freeze argument and Transfer events aren't required; the call either reverts (if caller not owner) or sets the frozenAccount getter to the provided value.
